sentences.text: Pararcus was a marine reptile belonging to the extinct order Placodontia, which is part of the larger superorder Sauropterygia.
The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — measures approximately 1.35 meters in length.
Fossil remains were found in the Vossenveld formation at Winterswijk, and the genus was described by Klein and Scheyer in 2013.
The holotype skeleton is incomplete and disarticulated, though it provides a clear size reference for the animal.
This creature lived during the Lower Anisian stage of the Middle Triassic in the warm waters of what is now the Netherlands.
